integrity: Finite verification is separate from the all-parameter mathematical proof; no independent audit or external certification is claimed. References are credited and omitted full text is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is restricted to the natural dihedral subgroup and rational homology of ordinary three-cut complexes of Möbius ladders for \(n\ge5\); it does not determine integral equivariant lattice structures or the quotient homotopy type. Nonequivariant sphere-wedge ranks were known. Later Möbius-ladder independence/perfect-matching preprint was only inspected via title and abstract; uncatalogued equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: The complete dihedral character of ordinary Möbius-ladder three-cut homology
